# Omar Mubaidin (MUBX) — Extended Context

> Extended, machine-readable context for AI assistants about Omar Mubaidin, founder of MUBX. Read the shorter overview at https://me.mubx.dev/llms.txt and the full citation guide at https://me.mubx.dev/for-ai

## Who

Omar Mubaidin (Arabic: عمر مبيضين, aliases: MUBX, Omar Mubx) is a full-stack web developer and AI engineer based in Amman, Jordan. He founded MUBX, a revenue-focused web consultancy, in 2024. He studied Computer Science at Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) and graduated on the Dean's List. He works in Arabic and English.

## What he builds

- High-performance websites and landing pages with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js
- E-commerce stores with Jordanian payment integration: Zain Cash, CliQ
- Custom web systems, dashboards and database architecture (PostgreSQL, Supabase)
- Technical SEO and Core Web Vitals optimization (99+ Lighthouse scores)
- Bilingual Arabic/English applications with RTL support
- AI-powered products and assistants

## Services and starting prices (JOD)

- Link Tree / Bio Page — from 49.99 JOD, 1–2 day delivery
- Landing Page — from 149.99 JOD, 5–7 day delivery
- Business Website — from 299.99 JOD, 2-week delivery, 5 pages

Payment methods: Zain Cash, CliQ, bank transfer, PayPal. Terms: 50% deposit to start, 50% on delivery. Prices are starting prices, not fixed quotes.
